name: io.github.mysterekkk/commerceweave-mcp
title: CommerceWeave MCP
description: One local MCP server for Allegro, Base.com and WooCommerce: read-only by default, human-approved writes.

environmentVariables.name: COMMERCEWEAVE_DEMO
environmentVariables.description: true = synthetic demo data, no credentials needed

environmentVariables.name: ALLEGRO_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: true to enable the Allegro connection

environmentVariables.name: BASE_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: true to enable the Base.com connection

environmentVariables.name: WOO_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: true to enable the WooCommerce connection

environmentVariables.name: WOO_STORE_URL
environmentVariables.description: https URL of the WooCommerce store
